name: ERIS
description: Eris is new: a compact, matte-black head shaped like the JP-2C. The cabinet's top front is cut away at a steep slant (about 55 degrees), and that slanted face is one sheet of black mesh framed by the cabinet edges, so the frame slants with it. Below it is a short, flat control panel with a solid-state look: no tubes, tick-mark dials, a thin teal light. CHANNEL picks the three JP-2C channels, VOICE steps through the captured settings on that channel, and BOOST adds the TS808 or Shred versions.
